gazette_source: eThekwini Council Minutes Special Budget Meeting March 2024
notes: eThekwini initially proposed higher increases. Council revised downward after public pressure. Electricity: 14% → 12.72% approved. Water: 14.9% → 10.9% approved. Note: eThekwini supplies electricity directly (not via entity like CoJ/Mangaung).

tariff_scale_3_4_credit.notes: Detailed rates require eThekwini tariff booklet. Source: https://www.durban.gov.za

tariff_scale_8_9_13_prepaid.notes: eThekwini does not use a separate flat 'home user charge' like CoCT. Prepaid structure is consumption-only.

water.notes: Bulk water increase from Umgeni was 9.5% which drove the 10.9% end-user increase. Detailed step tariff requires official tariff booklet.

refuse.notes: Reduced from proposed 8% after public participation.

property_rates.notes: Reduced from proposed 7.9% after public participation.
